description: Buyer: get the Lightning invoice that funds the escrow; after paying, call again with wait=true to lock the funds. Refuses when the deal expires within an hour (deadline + 1 h grace); an expired deal reports state expired. Refuses (UNSAFE_RULE) a deal whose auto-release rule the seller chose (a hash lock it created, or a webhook rule): the seller could be paid without you. Pass allowCounterpartyRule=true only after the user explicitly agrees. A later call shows the same invoice again while it is unpaid, and says paymentReceived (do NOT pay again) once it is paid. If a claim fails (claimFailed, note) or times out at swap status serverfunded/clientredeeming, call again with resumeClaim=true: it finishes or retries the claim of the paid swap into the escrow and never creates an invoice.

resumeClaim.description: finish/retry the Arkade claim of the already paid funding swap; no new invoice

name: escrow_fund
